name: statusline
description: One line under the prompt: the model and its effort, how full the context is, the plan's 5-hour and 7-day use with their resets, and what other mods put on it (smart-compact's ready or cold).

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Turn this mod off or on; /mods does it for all of the pack.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: line: one line under the prompt, merged with Claude Code's hint. tail: appended to that hint, dim. band: above the prompt. off: none.

limits.title: Plan usage
limits.description: always: the 5-hour and 7-day windows' use from the first reading, with when each resets. half: only once a window is half used. off: never.

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: A glint along the context gauge while Claude works.
